items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: I'm telling you I used to play with Zoo. Zoo was with the brass band.

ctx.x: Did you ever know Zoo Robertson on trombone? Zoo?

Zoo. I'm telling you I used to play with Zoo. Zoo was with the brass band. Mmhmm. Zoo was playing the brass band. Zoo was playing with the armored brass band. Zoo Robertson. Zoo Robertson. Noura Dutre. Rob Palmer. Vic Gasper. Field. And the old man Baptiste. Oh that was top musicians. You know. Top and Eddie Askin and all that fellas. Who? They never. They never. They never do that. Them. Yank. You know what you talk about Yanks? Yeah. Buddy Johnson. He was a popper. You see. A popper popper popper. You know.…
What style did he have? Who?
